versions.name: Camp Fawcett
versions.summary: A Texas Southwest Council camp on the Nueces River near Barksdale in the Texas Hill Country, offering riverfront campsites, a dining hall, and shooting and aquatics areas for unit camping.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Texas Southwest Council camp page, which confirms it as an active camp on the Nueces River near Barksdale (the source's council label is correct). Coordinates from scout-camp-map, approximate (US Census returned no match for the rural ranch-road address); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.
